name: Friendly mascot
direction: Friendly flat-vector mascot identity. A charming small tugboat with a device-shaped cabin and a subtle smiling front window, drawn with thick clean navy outlines. Minimal shapes, confident compact character suitable for a tiny app icon, not an elaborate illustration. Navy #1C344D, warm amber #F1B54A, sea teal #52AFAB. Soft rounded sans-serif Berth wordmark.
prompt: Create ONE original logo concept for Berth, a self-hosted Android emulator fleet for AI agents and humans. The concept is a safe assigned dock for a borrowed device. Produce a professional isolated brand logo, with one symbol above one wordmark except for the typographic option. The only text must be Berth (or berth when specified). Center on a pure white square canvas with generous margins. Keep the full lockup within the central 70 percent. Flat vector artwork, crisp paths, recognizable small silhouette. No mockups, photographs, shadows, textures, explanatory labels, taglines, watermarks, multiple alternatives, or famous-brand imitation. Friendly flat-vector mascot identity. A charming small tugboat with a device-shaped cabin and a subtle smiling front window, drawn with thick clean navy outlines. Minimal shapes, confident compact character suitable for a tiny app icon, not an elaborate illustration. Navy #1C344D, warm amber #F1B54A, sea teal #52AFAB. Soft rounded sans-serif Berth wordmark.
